title: Seba
summary: Raleigh names Seba in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Seba the sonne of Bichri, also printed Shebah, who rebelled against Dauid. Not Seba son of Cush. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter VII, §. IV, subsection I, sig. 224a
